entries.title: NieR
entries.definitive_edition: NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139... on Windows, plus original Gestalt route as secondary framing

emulation.emulator: None for primary; Xenia only for secondary preservation testing
emulation.notes: Native Windows Replicant for main route; Xbox 360 route only for Gestalt/Father framing.

primary.why: NieR originally released in Replicant/Gestalt forms on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360, with a protagonist-framing split between brother and father versions. NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139... is the modern enhanced route on Windows, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One, with a well-supported PC version. Because the modern route follows Replicant's brother protagonist, the original Gestalt/Father route is kept as secondary content.
primary.how_to_play: Use NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139... on Windows for the main playthrough. Then use the original Xbox 360/PS3 Gestalt-style release only if documenting the father-protagonist framing.

secondary.exclusive_content: Gestalt/Father NieR protagonist framing from the original release.
secondary.what_to_play: Document or sample the original father-protagonist route; do not replay the full game unless that framing is the archive goal.
secondary.why: The original release had a Replicant/Gestalt split, while the modern Replicant route uses the brother-protagonist version.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console route with regional Replicant/Gestalt differences.
all_releases.reason: skip: modern Replicant is the fidelity route; Xbox is the chosen secondary for Father/Gestalt documentation.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console route with the father-protagonist framing.
all_releases.reason: secondary: use only for the Gestalt/Father protagonist framing absent from modern Replicant.

all_releases.fidelity: Modern enhanced PC route with improved visuals/combat and best capture/settings ceiling.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity route for the main playthrough.
skip: no sourced exclusive content over Windows Replicant.
skip: no sourced exclusive content over Windows Replicant.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows Replicant ver.1.22474487139... is the fidelity pick, but the original Gestalt/Father protagonist framing is not the same and should be documented separately.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not erase the original Replicant/Gestalt distinction; the modern Replicant route is not the Father NieR version.

entries.title: NieR: Automata
entries.definitive_edition: Game of the YoRHa Edition / current Windows build

primary.version: Game of the YoRHa Edition / current PC build
primary.why: NieR: Automata released on PlayStation 4 and Windows, then Xbox One as Become as Gods Edition and Nintendo Switch as The End of YoRHa Edition. Windows with the Game of the YoRHa content is the highest-fidelity archive route, with a well-supported PC version and fixes available.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version with Game of the YoRHa content installed. Apply community fixes/settings before capture.

all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced exclusive story content over Windows complete route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC route with best capture/settings ceiling and complete-edition content.

all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced exclusive story content over Windows Game of the YoRHa route.

all_releases.platform: Nintendo Switch (The End of YoRHa Edition)
all_releases.reason: skip: portability and edition extras are useful, but Windows has the better capture/settings ceiling.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows complete-edition route is the fidelity pick and no sourced platform-exclusive story content is logged.

entries.remaster_caveats: Switch End of YoRHa is a useful portable edition, not the fidelity pick.

entries.title: NieR Reincarnation
entries.definitive_edition: No current playable definitive edition after service shutdown

emulation.notes: Service shutdown is the blocker, not emulation.

primary.version: Final mobile service build before shutdown
primary.why: NieR Reincarnation released on Android and iOS and ended worldwide service on April 29, 2024. Since no offline version is documented as released, iOS is only an archival target for preserved captures/materials rather than a normal current play route.
primary.how_to_play: No normal official play route is available after shutdown. Preserve official videos, captures, story summaries, and any legally retained local materials.

all_releases.reason: skip: service ended and no normal current play route is available.

all_releases.fidelity: Retired mobile live-service route; archival target only.
all_releases.reason: primary: chosen archival target despite no current official play route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The live service has ended, so completeness depends on preserved materials rather than normal play.

entries.remaster_caveats: Retired live-service mobile entry; do not present as normally playable.
